description: Tokenized Asset Purchase: submit the issuing or trading platform’s terms with the buyer and the purchase: optionally the platform with its id and name; the buyer with the jurisdiction, investor type (retail, accredited, qualified or institutional), whether identity checks are complete, the days the buyer means to hold and the purchase amount; the terms with the investor types the platform admits, the jurisdictions it admits and excludes, whether identity checks are required, the minimum and maximum purchase, the lockup in days, the platform’s right to freeze holdings and its right to claw them back, each with the conditions written for it, the fee schedule as written with each fee’s label, amount or percent, and the terms’ wording, read for sole discretion, may freeze, claw back, reverse or suspend without notice; and each fee charged on this purchase with its label and amount. The signed report gives the eligibility with the buyer’s jurisdiction and investor type against the lists, the identity checks and the purchase limits, the lockup beside the planned hold, the freeze and clawback rights with their conditions and the wording found, and every charge as matches, differs, not_in_schedule or unread against the written schedule, and counts them, and names blocking terms: an excluded jurisdiction or investor type, identity checks not complete, a purchase outside the limits, a lockup past the planned hold, a freeze or clawback right with no written conditions and a charge the schedule does not hold or sets at another amount; then freeze or clawback rights under written conditions and discretionary wording with no right set out, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No eligibility lists, an unstated buyer jurisdiction, investor type or identity status where the terms limit them, no lockup, unstated freeze or clawback rights and no written fee schedule leave the terms unverified. This reads one platform’s terms against one purchase: fee, refund and ownership clauses found in a terms page are wever_terms-evidence-check, a paid service’s terms from the paying side are wever_service-terms-check and liability terms agreed before an agent buys are wever_liability-terms-check. Verdict tokenized_terms_blocking, tokenized_terms_partial, tokenized_terms_unverified or tokenized_terms_acceptable. POST /api/tokenized-platform-terms-check. Reads the purchase records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Tokenized Asset Purchase reads the buyer’s own records for one purchase of a tokenized asset and checks each step before money moves: the quote against its stated terms, the platform’s terms against the buyer, the custody arrangement, the redemption path, the transfer restrictions, the settlement, the claimed backing and the full cost. Beside it, wever_atlas-asset-passport and wever_atlas-redemption-check read what the published Tokenization Atlas dataset records about an asset by its id, while a purchase check reads the records the buyer supplies for one purchase; and wever_vendor-quote-check and wever_price-truth-check read quotes and charges for goods, services and paid calls, while the quote and cost checks read a token purchase against its own terms. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/tokenized-purchase-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/tokenized-asset-purchase/.
